title: A refused site check read keeps its action, operation and the plugin's code in the chain diagnostics
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A refused read keeps its action, operation and the plugin's code; no message text reaches the diagnostics.

tests: a refused read keeps its action, operation and the plugin code, never the message
